basic_info.description: Prime location on Noe Street (between 19th and 20th St) in the heart of Eureka Valley/ Dolores Heights. A delightfully secluded retreat far above the street elevation for remarkable privacy. Both units are vacant. Two block walk to Mission Dolores Park. Three block walk to Castro Street. 28' wide by 105' deep upsloping lot with two structures: a two bedroom home in front with a large view deck, and an unwarranted 1 bed/ 1 bath structure in the rear with concrete foundation basement below. Front single family home tenants vacated via a buyout. Property full address is 655 and 655 1/2 Noe Street. There are two electrical meters and two electrical circuit boxes. Facing the street at sidewalk elevation is a single car garage. Bring your contractor.
